query.description: String input that fuzzy searches across `display_name`, `carrier_name`, and `uuid`.

Comma separated list of the carrier association of insurances you are searching for.

Note: This input must be an exact string match to work

Comma separated list of the carrier brand of insurances you are searching for.

Note: This input must be an exact string match to work

Comma separated list of the carrier name of insurances you are searching for.

Note: This input must be an exact string match to work
Two letter abbreviated state code of insurances you are searching for.
Exact string input of the plan name of insurances you are searching for.
Exact string input of the plan type of insurances you are searching for.
Exact string input of the display name of insurances you are searching for.

Comma separated list of the category of insurances you are searching for.

Note: This input must be an exact string match to work

Comma separated list of the category of insurances you wish to exclude.

Note: This input must be an exact string match to work
Single code input to search for plans with an exact string match within the codes field.

Partial string input to match to the codes field.
For Medicare Advantage plans this is a contract ID (i.e. H9572). For Federal or State Exchange plans this is the first 10 digits of the HIOS ID (i.e. 36096il100)

Note: This parameter can only be used if the `category` param is also utilized with a single category value.
